title: ArGen: Auto-Regulation of Generative AI via GRPO and Policy-as-Code
findings: The ArGen framework successfully operationalized principles from Dharmic ethics to align a medical AI assistant. The aligned model achieved a 70.9% improvement in 'Dharma' (scope adherence) and a 5.2% improvement in 'Ahimsa' (safety) compared to the baseline Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct model. This demonstrates the technical feasibility of integrating nuanced, non-Western, faith-based value systems into AI governance for improved ethical behavior.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured a Large Language Model's adherence to a culturally-specific ethical framework derived from Dharmic ethics (specifically principles of Ahimsa for non-harm/safety and Dharma for scope adherence/duty) in the context of a medical AI assistant. The principles were derived from texts like the Bhagavad Gita.
